description:
Fetch the validated extraction result for a completed job.

Only call once handinloop_get_job_status reports status 'completed' (calling earlier returns an error with the remaining time).

Returns: {
  job_id, task_type, status,
  fields: [{ name, value, confidence (0..1), human_verified }],
  line_items?: [...],            // for invoice-like documents
  audit_trail: [{ at, actor: system|ai|human, action }],
  discrepancies?: [{ field, expected, actual, delta, kind }],  // freight audit (#157)
  proof?: {                      // the signed Proof Object (#147)
    job_id, task_type, status, issued_at,
    fields: [{ name, value, confidence, verified_by: human|ai, verified_at? }],
    audit_trail: [...],
    signature?: { algorithm, key_id, value }   // absent if signing not configured
  }
}

Fields with human_verified=true were confirmed or corrected by a person on your own team, not the AI — treat confidence 1.0 as authoritative. The audit_trail documents every step for compliance purposes; preserve it when storing results.

The 'proof' is a portable, verifiable record: pass it downstream so another party can confirm this data's provenance by verifying the Ed25519 signature against HandInLoop's published public key (GET /v1/proof/public-key) — no callback needed. Preserve it intact; verified_by distinguishes human-signed fields from AI-verified ones. It's omitted only if the proof could not be retrieved.
name: handinloop_get_job_result
title: Get Job Result
